text:
The plate is square, about 26 cm across diagonally or roughly 22 cm per side, and spans about 390 px. That puts the scale at roughly 0.06 cm per px.

Each corn piece is about 80 px across, or about 4.8 cm. The two pieces are cross-cut sections of a corn cob, each about 2–3 cm thick.

Volume of one piece: π × 2.4² × 2.5 ≈ 45 cm³. The cob core takes up part of that, so I estimate about 35 g of kernels and cob per piece. For the two pieces together that is about 70 g.

The plate also holds a few small crumbs and stains, which are negligible.
